# HEIC test sample

`example.heic` is the libheif project’s public example image, downloaded from
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic on 2026-10-08.
It is used only to verify actual decoding and PNG output in local tests.
Upstream project/license: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif (LGPL-3.0).
The fixture is not included in application packages.
